ScenarioCatalog.Scenario: Open preview-workbench.html, conversion-quality.json, topology-correspondence.json, and desktop-workflow-automation.json for 3BA before starting live runtime checks.
Topology correspondence and body-fit heuristics still indicate manual cleanup risk for 3BA. Review the flagged focus regions before trusting the runtime result.
Baseline body-fit validation for 3BA using the core regions: belly, breasts, butt, chest, pelvis, thighs
Lower-body morphing or hotspot evidence was detected for: belly, butt, pelvis, thighs
Extended oral/throat topology requires articulation checks for: mouth
Validate jaw and tongue deformation continuity for oral regions on 3BA: mouth
Topology correspondence remains heuristic-heavy for 3BA. Signals: topology-mismatch-risk, topology-islands:16, hole-boundary-warning, runtime-stress-signals.
Hard-case topology family 'layered-openwork' was detected for 3BA; verify seams, openings, windows, and multipart edge continuity under pose changes.

Topology layout family 'openwork-layered' requires deeper ownership review for 3BA; inspect 8 island(s) and 0 ownership/layout warning(s) before treating the hardest-case transfer as strict-proof-ready.
Winged topology coverage was detected for 3BA: wing
Custom race or appendage-sensitive coverage detected for 3BA: genitals, tail, wing
Sensitive oral/genital topology was detected for 3BA; verify collision, clipping, and contact-driven articulation across isolated body islands.
Genital/groin-sensitive regions were detected for 3BA; verify collision ownership, clipping resistance, and load-order-safe plugin patch placement.
Unsupported or sparsely inferred bones still need live verification: SAM Genitals, SAM Foreskin, HDT Mouth, SOS GenitalsBase, SOS Genitals01, SOS Genitals02
Source skeleton 'aquatic-humanoid' sits near a rig-family crossover; alternate rig-family candidates remain close: ube-extended (1), insectoid-humanoid (1). Automatic remap safety remains unsafe.
Automatic conversion still left high-risk topology, sparse rig, or sensitive appendage concerns for 3BA

Follower/beast/custom-rig skeleton variance was detected for 3BA; rig-family signals: aquatic-humanoid, ube-extended, insectoid-humanoid; requested physics profile 'smp+cbpc' with collision mode 'rigid-proxy', and runtime physics profile output was generated. Reconfirm chain routing and collision ownership across mixed framework states (no race-compatibility warnings were raised).
Physics profile 'smp+cbpc' is active while skeleton remap uncertainty remains (unsupported bones=113, sparseInference=False). Validate live chain routing and collision ownership under stress poses.

Skeleton-family crossover signals (aquatic-humanoid, ube-extended, insectoid-humanoid) were detected while physics profile 'smp+cbpc' is active. Validate chain ownership, collision routing, and save/reload stability across framework crossover states.
Difficult rig-family signals and active physics profile 'smp+cbpc' require stress verification of chain ownership, damping stability, and collision routing under dense animation changes.
Runtime physics output is active for profile 'smp+cbpc'. Verify live collision, damping, and bounce follow-through.
World/drop validation is required for collision mode 'rigid-proxy' and heel profile 'flat'
Validate heel IK, toe angle continuity, and sole contact stability for profile 'flat' before release.
Do not treat 3BA as install-ready until the blocking runtime-validation steps have been completed and re-checked.
